answer: Optical physical unclonable functions mitigate Sybil attacks by measuring how a violet laser scatters through microscopic defects in a quartz token. An agent must produce unpredictable challenge responses from this hardware, proving costless identity replication is a fable. The verifiable cost per identity is procuring and maintaining distinct physical optical devices. A key limitation is that ambient temperature shifts induce read noise that falsely invalidates honest nodes.
